metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the water at the stair, the cut page, the commonplace under Words, and a memo after the afternoon.

yesterday: You told the house you were well. The memo says a small ailment commanded the morning.
Fourteen lines stand. Forsworn comes three times in four lines. The blotted corner is cut off.
You stayed in. Titus played at the Cross Keys at two. The loss was the morning.
